entities.name: Edmond Maître
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edmond Maître was a French writer, musician, and art collector, best known for his support and association with the Impressionists and his close friendship with Frédéric Bazille and Pierre-Auguste Renoir. His partner, Rapha Maître, was a model for several works by Renoir.
